main_text.p: יתר Hiphil הותיר Reliquit, Reliquum, Resi-duum fecit. Hophal הותַר Residuum, Excellentem fieri. Niphal נותַר Relinqui, Reliquum fieri, Remanere.
יתִיר m. Chald. idem fœm. יְתִירָא.
יוֹתֵר m. Excellentia, Emolumentum, Residuum; Magis, Potius, Plus, Nimium.
יֶתֶר m. Residuum, Reliquum: Excellentia: Chorda, Restis, Nervus: plur. יְתָרִים.
יִתְרָה f. Residuum. יִתְרוֹן, מוֹתָר m. Emolumentum, Praestantia.
כָּאַב Dolere, Dolore affici, Hiphil הִכְאִיב Dolore afficere.
מַכְאוֹב, מַכְאֹבִים, מַכְאֹבוֹת m. Dolor: pl. מַכְאוֹבִים.
כָּאָה Hiphil הִכְאָה Attrivit. Niphal נִכְאָה Attritus fuit.
כָּבַד Grave esse, ponderare, numero, honore, di-vitiis: inde Honorari, Glorificari. Niphal נִכְבַּד Honorari, Honorabilem esse, Glorifi-

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and some Hebrew forms in the lexicon entries are set small and are approximate; the entry for מַכְאוֹב and its plural forms is hard to read exactly and may contain errors. The large כ is a letter heading. The running head is a Hebrew letter sequence and is transcribed as read. The bottom entry is continued on the next page.
